first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the 4% completion decline and is supported by durable gains in time-to-value and early adoption. Promotional pricing could counter the competitor, but its documented 30-day retention harm conflicts with the objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Verify both the strongest onboarding evidence and the pricing downside before committing.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified prior test improved completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%, directly addressing the current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable revenue. Reject promotional pricing despite competitive pressure because the verified cohort gained qualified revenue short term but suffered 12% lower 30-day retention and failed to survive the first renewal cycle. Historical results are strong but should still be revalidated under current conditions.
